finding.detail: The setup owner captures original NTT/ff objects, but does not validate original value-to-NTT/NTT-to-ff and table/control edges before rescanning at close. Replacing an ff/table field inside an original context can be accepted into the cleanup inventory and its foreign array wait called. The original ctx attachment guard alone does not catch it.
finding.required_change: Freeze original returned/attached NTT and ff/table/control graph at first observation. Validate before later traversal; on change reject and still attempt only retained original array barriers. Preserve385 and use separately pinned successor.

scope: Static source/archive/AST checks only. No genuine backend, device, capacity, numerical or actual authority evidence.
